title: UserRegisteredEvent
description: JSON schema for user.registered.v1 event emitted by auth-service upon user registration or staff account provisioning.

eventId.description: Unique event identifier for consumer deduplication and idempotency.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the user was created.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the registered user (partition key for user.registered.v1).

email.description: Primary email address of the registered user.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number, if provided during registration.

role.description: System role assigned to the user.

merchantId.description: Associated merchant ID if the user was provisioned for a merchant account.

enabled.description: Whether the user account is active immediately.
